summary: WhiteHawk Minerals filed an 8-K reporting a Dealer Manager Agreement with Preferred Capital Securities and the effectiveness of its Form S-1 for an offering of up to 100,000 shares of Series F Redeemable Preferred Stock at a public offering price of up to $1,000 per share stated value, with cumulative dividends at a fixed 7.5% annually. The Certificate of Designations was filed in Delaware on October 1, 2026. Redemption is at holder option prior to any exchange listing and at company option after one year. This is an ordinary preferred shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch subscription pace.
